name: Justice & Diversity Center (JDC)
description: Pro bono legal services for low-income/unhoused San Francisco residents and local nonprofits that serve low-income communities
fullDescription: The Justice & Diversity Center is the nonprofit arm of the Bar Association of San Francisco, providing free legal services to those who cannot afford attorneys.
whatTheyOffer:
- Legal Advice and Referral Clinic (LARC)
- Homeless Advocacy Project (HAP) for unhoused San Franciscans
- Pro bono help in nearly every area of civil law, including eviction and domestic violence
- Special Immigrant Juvenile Status (SIJS) Project and Immigrant Legal Defense Program
- Community Organization Representation Project (CORP) for nonprofits serving low-income communities
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the JDC Legal Services Programs page or call 415-982-1600 (Monday–Friday, 9 AM–5 PM)
2. Unhoused residents can visit the Homeless Advocacy Project drop-in intake clinic at 125 Hyde Street, Tuesday–Friday, 1–3 PM (415-575-3130)
3. Complete intake and eligibility screening
4. If eligible, receive free legal advice or representation
5. Nonprofits can apply to CORP separately
address: 50 Fremont Street, Suite 1700, San Francisco, CA 94105
